Skills.Name: Cryomancy
Skills.Description: Cold mastery. Cold-element spells deal +25% damage when the target is Wet or Frozen. Pair with a water-source mutation to soak the target first, then chill them for the freezerburn bonus.

Powers.Name: Brittle Strike
Powers.Description: +50% melee damage on Frozen targets, applied as bonus Cold damage. Works with any weapon — your spells set up the kill, your blade finishes it.

Powers.Name: Frost Retort
Powers.Description: When an attack on you misses, your chill aura nips back — 3 Cold damage to the attacker.

Powers.Name: Frostbind
Powers.Description: Active ability: lock an adjacent target's movement for 4 turns. Target can still attack and cast — only their cell is frozen. 35-turn cooldown.

Powers.Name: Hibernate
Powers.Description: Active ability: enter self-stasis for 10 turns. Cannot act, but heals 5% of max HP per turn AND has 100% Heat + Cold resistance. 200-turn cooldown.

Powers.Name: Rime Grip
Powers.Description: Freezes 1 target at range 5. Wet targets freeze harder.

Powers.Name: Glacial Wall
Powers.Description: Raises 3 cells of ice. Melts after 8 turns.

Powers.Name: Cold Snap
Powers.Description: Hobbles everything within 2. No damage — buys turns.

Powers.Name: Ice Lance
Powers.Description: A lance of bitter cold: 1d6 cold damage in a line, range 6, with a deep chill (−300J) that freezes what it strikes — frozen metal turns brittle. Cooldown 8. Also taught by the Ice Lance grimoire.

Powers.Name: Rime Nova
Powers.Description: A ring of rime: 1d6 cold to every creature within radius 2, Frozen on survivors, and a −200J chill over everything in the blast. Cooldown 15. Also taught by the Rime Nova grimoire.

Powers.Name: Chill Draft
Powers.Description: Exhale a chill draft: everything adjacent to you loses 100J of heat — snuff embers, cool overheating gear, take the edge off a brewing fire. Cooldown 5. Also taught by the Chill Draft grimoire.
